tape-hero.purpose: The HACKATHON strip only; splits into HACKA / THON below 600px.

tape-m.purpose: Section headings and mobile menu items.

tape-l.purpose: Primary actions, the hero deadline, labels in the machine tray.

tape-s.purpose: Default tape: navigation, statuses, dates, inline tapes in lists and tables.

headline.purpose: The challenge question in the drawer, max 24ch.

label.purpose: Real field and column labels only: hero fact terms, holder label, table headers, footer column headings, machine field label.

tape-final.purpose: The three stacked strips of the final call heading.

tape-plate.purpose: The red Semana de Tecnologia plate under HACKATHON.

tape-holder.purpose: The theme tape inside the drawer label holder.

detail.purpose: Control details, link notes, the tray hint.

numeral.purpose: Course control numbers and the machine field input.

numeral-small.purpose: Low end of the drawer theme tape.

label-time.purpose: Schedule times and the review panel.

shadows.name: tape-shadow
shadows.purpose: Every tape at rest (filter, follows the scissor-cut outline).

shadows.name: tape-shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on interactive tape, with 1px rise and brightness(1.06).

shadows.name: tape-shadow-pressed
shadows.purpose: Active state: tape pushed 2px into the surface.

shadows.name: paper-sheet
shadows.purpose: The regulation sheet resting on the bench.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Label holder, character wheel and exit slot (slot deepens to inset 0 4px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75)).

shadows.name: tape-skin
shadows.value: 96px fractal-noise grain at 9% white + linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2) 0, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 34%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 52%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) 100%)
shadows.purpose: Vinyl sheen and grain on every tape body; not a shadow but the only surface texture.

shadows.name: emboss
shadows.value: SVG filters #emboss-s, #emboss, #emboss-l, #emboss-xl: feDiffuseLighting + feSpecularLighting, distant light azimuth 225deg, elevation 52-56deg, plus a short offset cast; -l and -xl add plastic-stress whitening and edge bleed
shadows.purpose: Raises the letters on every tape face by size.

shadows.name: machine
shadows.purpose: The label-maker housing resting on the bench (housing sheen ends at rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18)).

shadows.name: slot-recess
shadows.purpose: Exit slot the tape feeds from.

shadows.name: swatch-edge
shadows.purpose: Bottom edge of an inline placeholder swatch.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: One firm press on interactive tape (translate), filter at 160ms.

motion.name: tape-feed
motion.value: GSAP clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0), 0.7s power2.inOut (0.45s per strip, 0.35s stagger on phones)
motion.purpose: HACKATHON tape feeds out on load, then letters punch in sequence.

motion.name: letter-punch
motion.value: GSAP scale 1.4-1.45 to 1, opacity 0.2/0 to 1, 0.16-0.22s back.out(3), 0.035s stagger
motion.purpose: Letters punched into tape (hero, drawer theme on view, label maker per keystroke).

motion.name: heading-press
motion.value: GSAP from y -18, scale 1.06, opacity 0, 0.55s back.out(1.8), once at top 88%
motion.purpose: Section heading strips pressed onto the surface as they arrive.

motion.name: course-draw
motion.value: GSAP strokeDashoffset to 0, ScrollTrigger scrub 0.6, top 75% to bottom 60%
motion.purpose: The participation route's course line drawn as the visitor scrolls.

motion.name: label-drop
motion.purpose: A cut label falls into the tray below the machine.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables GSAP entrances and smooth scroll; transitions 0.01ms
motion.purpose: All content visible and in place without motion.

narrative.overview:
The site is a lab bench where the organizers label everything with an embossed label maker. Every confirmed fact is a strip of tape with raised off-white letters punched into it; every unconfirmed fact is yellow tape still waiting for its letters. Tape is the only display voice: headings, navigation, actions, dates, statuses and the event name are all strips of vinyl, rotated a degree or two, cut with scissors, and lightly shadowed onto the surface they sit on. Running text stays quiet in Switzer on a cool laminate bench.

The world is built from four physical surfaces: the cool-gray bench (ground for most sections), a dark steel cabinet drawer for the challenge, a white punched paper sheet for the regulations, and a working label-maker machine for the final call. Depth comes from the objects themselves (tape thickness, a recessed label holder, a molded machine body), never from decorative gradients, glow or glassy layers. Density is moderate: generous section padding on an 8px module, ruled lists and tables for reference material, and tape doing the ranking by length and color.

Motion is the act of labelling: tape feeds out of the machine, letters punch in sequence, heading strips are pressed onto the surface as they arrive, the participation route is drawn as a course line while the visitor scrolls, and controls answer with one firm press. Under reduced motion nothing moves and everything is already in place.
keyCharacteristics: Embossed label tape as the single display primitive, with color carrying role.
Sometype Mono 700 uppercase for every tape; Switzer for everything a person reads at length.
Cool bench, dark steel, white paper: three surfaces, each a real material.
Tapes never wrap; long strips are punched as two or three stacked, counter-rotated strips.
Placeholders are visibly unfinished: yellow tape with a dashed underline.
Motion describes the label maker working, and is fully optional.

rules.name: The Cartridge Rule
rules.body: A tape's color is its role: black structure and navigation, green actions, red the event plate and deadlines, yellow pending, blue outbound, gray unpublished, white on dark or current. No tape takes a color for decoration.

rules.name: The Red Is Pressure Rule
rules.body: Red appears on the Semana de Tecnologia plate and on deadlines only. A second use dilutes the one word under pressure.

rules.name: The Color Lives In Tape Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay neutral (bench, steel, paper). Saturated color enters the page only as tape, a placeholder swatch, the course line or a focus outline.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sometype Mono 700 uppercase is for tape and field labels; Switzer is for sentences. Never set a paragraph in the tape face or a tape in Switzer.

rules.name: The Never Wrap Rule
rules.body: Tapes are `white-space: nowrap`. A heading strip wider than its column is re-punched as two or three strips, split by words, stacked and counter-rotated (first about -1.4deg, next about +0.9deg and indented). On phones HACKATHON becomes HACKA / THON. Narrow screens step a tape down a size rather than let it wrap or overflow.

rules.name: The Light From Upper Left Rule
rules.body: Raised letters are lit by one distant light at azimuth 225deg through the SVG filters (#emboss-s for small tape, #emboss for default, #emboss-l and #emboss-xl with plastic-stress whitening for large tape). Tape depth never uses box-shadow or text-shadow bevels.

rules.name: The Vinyl Skin Rule
rules.body: Every tape body carries the same skin: a 96px fractal-noise grain at 9% and a sheen fading from 20% white at the top to 12% black at the bottom. Gradients elsewhere only shade a physical material (machine body, bar pull, punch holes, brushed steel); none decorates, and nothing glows.

dos: Do make every new display element a tape and choose its color by role from the Cartridge Rule.
Do keep tapes on one line; re-punch long strips as two or three stacked, counter-rotated strips, or step down one size on narrow screens.
Do rotate tapes slightly (about -3deg to +1.6deg), alternating between neighbours, and let the per-strip hash cut each end.
Do render every unconfirmed fact as yellow pending tape (whole value) or a yellow inline swatch (inside a sentence), always with the dashed underline as the non-color cue.
Do raise letters only through the #emboss filters and lift tape only with the drop-shadow tokens.
Do keep motion to the label-maker grammar: feed out, punch letters, press headings on, draw the course line, one firm press on controls; with reduced motion, show everything in place.
Do place the IFSP logo, complete and uncolored, on white with clear space.
donts: Don't use red for anything other than the Semana de Tecnologia plate and deadlines.
Don't wrap a tape onto two lines or let it overflow the viewport.
Don't bevel tape with box-shadow or text-shadow, or add decorative gradients, glows or glassy layers; the only blur is the functional sticky masthead over the bench.
Don't set running text in Sometype Mono or tape lettering in Switzer.
Don't present a placeholder as finished copy, or invent dates, prizes, rules or sponsors to fill one.
Don't recolor, crop, place on tape, or shrink the IFSP mark below a 30px symbol.
Don't add icons outside the five-icon stroke set or use glyphs as icons.
